headline: Cleanest window in the four-day forecast is this morning - gusts 36 at dawn against yesterday's 87 - so the brick is on at 07:00.
body:
The wind gave you the day back. **Gusts 36 km/h at dawn easing to 29 by midday**, against the **87 km/h** that pushed this session off Saturday. Roll out at 07:00: **16 C early, 26 C by midday**, so it is the heat and not the wind that bites on the back half.

One thing to know - the sync last ran at **12:46 yesterday**, so nothing from this morning reached me. No HRV, no sleep, and no file for Saturday's 1,800 m. Did the swim happen? The last read I have was a good one: **HRV 64 against a 14-day mean of 61**, the first above-baseline morning since 31 August. Before you clip in, tell me where the right ankle is on rotation.

**85 km at 140-150 bpm**, cap **155** on the climbs, keep pedalling over the tops. Then straight off into **20 min at 6:45-7:00/km, 145-155 bpm**. **80-90 g carbs an hour from the first hour**. Charge the watch.
